# Requirements Quality Checklist: Composting State Machine Tests

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for prerequisite fixes and test coverage — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and scenario coverage
**Created**: 2026-09-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact semantics of "maturation capped at 5" defined — does the level stay at 5 indefinitely, or can it never be incremented beyond 5? [Completeness, Spec §FR-1.11] — SATISFIED: Data model §Maturation Rules: "MaturationLevel += 1 (capped at 5)"; validation: "MaturationLevel must be between 1 and MaturationMaxLevel (5)". Cap prevents incrementing beyond 5; level stays at 5 until reset by 14 idle days.
- [x] CHK002 Is the post-collection behavior of `MaturationLevel` specified — does it remain unchanged, reset, or decrement after `CollectCompost`? [Gap, Spec §FR-1.13] — SATISFIED: FR-1.11 states "ConsecutiveActiveDays is NOT reset on collection"; data model §Transition Rules: "Ready → Empty: Produce MaturationLevel compost items, reset state" (state = CompostingBinState, not MaturationLevel). MaturationLevel persists across collection.
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for testing the merged `ModController.OnButtonPressed` handler (Fix-2) — is there an FR verifying right-click waste add / compost collect works after the merge? [Gap, Spec §Fix-2] — RESOLVED (2026-09-09 clarification): Focused FR added for controller event delegation (`OnButtonPressed` → service). Spec §Clarifications records the decision.
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for testing save/load round-trip of `ConsecutiveActiveDays` (Fix-3) — is there an FR verifying persistence survives a save/load cycle? [Gap, Spec §Fix-3] — RESOLVED (2026-09-09 clarification): Covered by task T050b; no additional FR needed beyond FR-1.11.
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for testing the production implementations of `TimeProvider`, `SeasonProvider`, `PlayerProvider` — do they correctly wrap `Game1` static properties? [Gap, Spec §Fix-4] — RESOLVED (2026-09-09 clarification): Explicitly out-of-scope for dedicated FR testing — one-line `Game1` wrappers verified by interface/stub contracts; low risk documented.
- [x] CHK006 Is the expected behavior of `AddWaste` when called on a non-Empty bin with an invalid item specified — is it a no-op (like FR-1.5/1.6) or does validation happen before state check? [Gap, Spec §FR-1.5, FR-1.6] — SATISFIED: FR-1.5/1.6 state "silently ignored; bin state remains Processing/Ready" regardless of item. Data model §Transition Rules: "Processing → Processing: AddWaste() called → No state change." State check precedes validation; no-op for any non-Empty bin.
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for `ProcessDayStart` when called multiple times within the same day — is it idempotent? [Gap, Spec §FR-1.9] — RESOLVED (2026-09-09 clarification): Idempotent by design (`currentDay - recordedDay >= MaturationDays` yields no change for same `TotalDays`). No separate FR needed.
- [x] CHK008 Is the format and constraints of a "valid save ID" defined for FR-6.1 — what characters, length, or pattern constitute valid? [Gap, Spec §FR-6.1] — SATISFIED: Data model §Constants: MaxSaveIdLength = 200. Tasks T072-T076 define validation: not null, not empty, not whitespace, ≤200 chars. SaveIdProvider is pass-through; validity = passing these constraints.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "active day" explicitly defined for FR-1.11 maturation counting — is it any day the bin is not Empty, only Processing days, or days when `ProcessDayStart` advances state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-1.11] — SATISFIED: Data model §Maturation Rules: "7 consecutive active days (Processing) → MaturationLevel += 1". Spec clarification: "Count active days across multiple add→process→collect cycles." Active day = day bin spends in Processing state.
- [x] CHK010 Is "idle day" explicitly defined for FR-1.12 — does it require the bin to be Empty for the full day, or is it counted from the last `AddWaste` call? [Clarity, Spec §FR-1.12] — SATISFIED: Data model §Maturation Rules: "14 consecutive idle days (Empty) → MaturationLevel = 1". Validation: "ConsecutiveIdleDays must be between 0 and MaturationIdleResetDays (14)". Idle day = day bin spends in Empty state.
- [x] CHK011 Is the soil health increase in FR-2.1 specified as additive (current + 15) or absolute (set to 15)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-2.1] — SATISFIED: FR-2.1 says "increases soil health by 15" (additive). FR-2.2 confirms: "does not exceed 100 after application" — only makes sense if additive. Contracts §CompostApplicationServiceFixture shows starting health 50f + 15f = 65f.
- [x] CHK012 Is the decay application scope in FR-3.1 clarified — does "soil health decreases" apply to all tiles, only bare tiles (`crop == null`), or only tiles with specific terrain feature types? [Clarity, Spec §FR-3.1] — SATISFIED: Contracts §SoilDecayServiceTests: "ProcessDayStart_CoveredTile_NoDecay: tile with crop → no decay". Quickstart Scenario 7: bare HoeDirt tiles. Research: SoilDecayService iterates terrainFeatures.Pairs; only bare tiles (crop == null) decay.
- [x] CHK013 Is "invalid season" in FR-5.5 explicitly defined — does it include null, empty string, numeric values, or any string not in {spring, summer, fall, winter}? [Clarity, Spec §FR-5.5] — SATISFIED: Contracts §SeasonalDecayMultiplierTests: "GetMultiplier_InvalidSeason_ReturnsDefault: 'invalid' → 0.5f". Any string not in {spring, summer, fall, winter} returns default 0.5x multiplier.
- [x] CHK014 Is the NFR-1 execution time threshold clarified — is this 5 seconds for the entire test suite, per test file, or per test method? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-1] — SATISFIED: NFR-1: "All tests must execute in under 5 seconds". Quickstart: "All tests complete in under 5 seconds". Scope = entire test suite.
- [x] CHK015 Is FR-6.2's "null/empty" return value disambiguated — does the method return `null`, `string.Empty`, or is it context-dependent? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-6.2] — SATISFIED: Contracts §SaveIdProviderTests: "GetSaveId_WithNullSaveFolder_ReturnsNull: null → Returns null" and "GetSaveId_WithEmptySaveFolder_ReturnsNull: empty → returns null". Both null and empty return `null` (not string.Empty).

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 Are FR-1.5/1.6 (add waste silently ignored) and FR-1.7/1.8 (collect returns 0) consistent in their no-op semantics — both specify no state change, no exception, no log? [Consistency, Spec §FR-1.5–1.8] — SATISFIED: FR-1.5/1.6: "silently ignored; bin state remains". FR-1.7/1.8: "returns 0 (no compost produced)". Clarification: "No exception, no state transition, no log message — the method is a no-op for non-Empty bins." All four FRs are consistent.
- [x] CHK017 Is NFR-4 ("no reflection to access private state") consistent with the SaveIdProvider test approach that uses reflection to set `Constants.SaveFolderName`? [Conflict, Spec §NFR-4, §Clarifications] — SATISFIED: Spec clarification Session 2026-09-08: "Use reflection to set Constants.SaveFolderName via BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static". NFR-4 prohibits reflection for private state; SaveIdProvider uses reflection on a public static field — explicit exception documented in spec.
- [x] CHK018 Is the assumption "project uses xUnit and Moq" consistent with the plan's use of real `GameLocation`/`HoeDirt` objects instead of mocks for location-iteration tests? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, §Plan Test Patterns] — SATISFIED: Plan Pattern 3 uses real GameLocation/HoeDirt for location-iteration tests where mocking is impractical (GameLocation is not mockable). Moq is still used for interface dependencies (ISoilHealthService, IMonitor). Both patterns coexist; this follows SMAPI mod testing standard.
- [x] CHK019 Is FR-1.11 (maturation after 7 active days) consistent with FR-1.13 (output equals maturation level) — if level can reach 5, does collecting at level 5 return 5 items? [Consistency, Spec §FR-1.11, FR-1.13] — SATISFIED: FR-1.11: "maturation level increases by 1 (capped at 5)". FR-1.13: "Collecting compost produces exactly MaturationLevel compost items". At level 5, collect returns 5. MaturationLevel never exceeds 5, so output is always 1-5. Consistent.
- [x] CHK020 Is the assumption "one-file-per-subject" consistent with the plan's creation of `Stubs/` and `Fixtures/` subdirectories containing multiple helper files? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, §Plan Project Structure] — SATISFIED: One-file-per-subject refers to test files ({Subject}Tests.cs). Stubs/ and Fixtures/ contain helper infrastructure (TimeProviderStub, GameLocationFixture, etc.), not test subjects. Test files remain one-per-subject in LivingRoots.Tests/ root.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK021 Is Success Criterion 1 ("all public methods have at least one test") measurable — is the list of public methods for each service explicitly enumerated or referenced? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria] — SATISFIED: Spec §Success Criteria lists 7 services. Contracts §test-patterns.md enumerates test scenarios per service covering all public methods (AddWaste, CollectCompost, ProcessDayStart, GetBinState, TryApplyCompost, IsValidOrganicWaste, GetMultiplier, GetSaveId, CreateBin).
- [x] CHK022 Is Success Criterion 4 ("every test has at least one assertion") verifiable — can this be checked statically without running tests? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria] — SATISFIED: Tasks T082: "grep test files for Assert. calls, confirm count matches test count". This is a static check — count Assert. occurrences vs test method count.
- [x] CHK023 Are the acceptance criteria for FR-1.11 specific enough to write a deterministic test — does "7 consecutive active days" translate to exactly 7 calls to `ProcessDayStart` with specific `TotalDays` values? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-1.11] — SATISFIED: Quickstart Scenario 3: "For days 2-8: set TimeProviderStub.TotalDays and call ProcessDayStart('Farm') each day. Verify MaturationLevel increased from 1 to 2." Tasks T035 covers this. 7 ProcessDayStart calls with advancing TotalDays.
- [x] CHK024 Is FR-2.2's acceptance criteria ("does not exceed 100") testable without knowing the starting health value — is the starting condition specified? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-2.2] — SATISFIED: Contracts §CompostApplicationServiceTests: "TryApplyCompost_HealthCappedAtMax: near max health → capped at 100". Tasks T046: starting health near max (e.g., 90f), apply +15f, verify cap at 100f. Starting condition is set in test arrange phase.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for `ProcessDayStart` when `TotalDays` decreases (time goes backward) — is this an expected scenario or explicitly out of scope? [Coverage, Gap] — RESOLVED (2026-09-09 clarification): Explicitly out-of-scope — `ITimeProvider.TotalDays` is monotonic by game design (`Game1.Date.TotalDays` never decreases).
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for `AddWaste` when the waste item has category 0 (uncategorized) — is this tested as valid, invalid, or edge case? [Coverage, Spec §FR-4.1] — RESOLVED (2026-09-09 clarification): Category 0 is not in valid list (`-74..-81`) and is rejected by design; documented implicitly in FR-4.1 validation notes.
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for testing `SaveIdProvider` behavior across a save/load cycle — does the ID persist or change? [Coverage, Spec §FR-6.3] — RESOLVED (2026-09-09 clarification): Explicitly out-of-scope — ID derives from persistent `Constants.SaveFolderName`; session-level consistency (FR-6.3) is sufficient.
- [x] CHK028 Are concurrent access requirements (US1 "concurrent access") mapped to specific FR items — is there an FR verifying thread-safety of `AddWaste`/`CollectCompost`? [Coverage, Spec §US1, Gap] — RESOLVED (2026-09-09 clarification): Covered by US1 + clarification 2026-09-08 (`Task.Run` thread test T050). No separate FR needed.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK029 Is the behavior specified for `CollectCompost` on a Ready bin with `MaturationLevel = 0` — is this possible, and if so, what does it return? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-1.13] — SATISFIED: Data model §Validation Rules: "MaturationLevel must be between 1 and MaturationMaxLevel (5)". MaturationLevel = 0 is impossible by design (minimum is 1). FR-7.2 confirms factory creates bin with MaturationLevel=1. Edge case cannot occur.
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for `ProcessDayStart` when the bin has `InputTimestamp = null` (Empty state) — is this a no-op or does it throw? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-1.9] — SATISFIED: Tasks T039: "ProcessDayStart_EmptyLocation_IsNoOp: process empty location → no exception". Data model: InputTimestamp is null when Empty. ProcessDayStart on Empty bin is a no-op (no state change, no exception).
- [x] CHK031 Is the behavior specified for `AddWaste` when called with the same item multiple times on an Empty bin — does it accumulate or replace? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-1.2] — SATISFIED: FR-1.2: first AddWaste transitions Empty → Processing. FR-1.5: subsequent AddWaste while Processing is silently ignored. Spec clarification: "Full lifecycle: add waste → process → ready → collect → add again." No accumulation; second call is no-op.
- [x] CHK032 Are requirements defined for `SoilDecayService` when a location has zero terrain features — is this a no-op or does it throw? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-3.1] — SATISFIED: Tasks T039: "ProcessDayStart_EmptyLocation_IsNoOp: process empty location → no exception". Research §Edge Cases: "Empty runtime cache: ProcessDayStart on empty location is a no-op." Zero terrain features = no-op.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK033 Is NFR-2 ("no external systems") clarified regarding reflection — does setting `Constants.SaveFolderName` via reflection count as an external dependency? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-2] — SATISFIED: NFR-2: "Tests must not depend on external systems (file system, network)". Reflection to set an in-process static field is not an external system. Spec clarification explicitly approves this approach for SaveIdProvider tests.
- [x] CHK034 Is NFR-3 ("deterministic") achievable given the plan's use of real `GameLocation` objects — are there any non-deterministic behaviors in `GameLocation` or `HoeDirt` that could affect tests? [Feasibility, Spec §NFR-3] — SATISFIED: Plan Pattern 3 creates GameLocation with controlled inputs (specific tile coordinates, specific HoeDirt states). No time/random dependencies in test logic. All inputs controlled via stubs (ITimeProvider, ISeasonProvider). Determinism preserved by design.
- [x] CHK035 Are requirements defined for test parallelization safety — does the spec address whether tests can run in xUnit's default parallel mode? [Gap, Spec §NFR-3] — SATISFIED: Success Criteria 5: "Tests can run in any order without shared mutable state." Fix-4 extracts Game1 static dependencies behind interfaces, eliminating static mutable state. Each test creates fresh fixtures. No shared state = parallelization-safe.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 Is the assumption "CompostingBinService uses Game1.Date.TotalDays" validated — does the current implementation actually use this, or is this only true after Fix-1? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — SATISFIED: Spec §Assumptions explicitly states this is true "After fixes" and Fix-1 changes the implementation to use ITimeProvider.TotalDays. The assumption is validated as a post-fix invariant, not a current state.
- [x] CHK037 Is the dependency "test project must reference main project" verified — is `InternalsVisibleTo` configured for all new internal types introduced by Fix-4? [Dependency, Spec §Dependencies] — SATISFIED: Spec §Dependencies: "Test project must reference the main project (already configured via InternalsVisibleTo)". AGENTS.md confirms InternalsVisibleTo("LivingRoots.Tests") is set. New interfaces (ITimeProvider, ISeasonProvider, IPlayerProvider) are public — accessible without InternalsVisibleTo.
- [x] CHK038 Is the assumption "GameLocation(string mapPath, string name)" validated against the actual Stardew Valley version the mod targets — could this signature change across game versions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — SATISFIED: Spec clarification Session 2026-09-07, Round 2: "Binary analysis shows the actual signature is GameLocation(string mapPath, string name)". Validated against the actual game binary. Cross-version risk is inherent to modding but the current target is validated.

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK039 Is the conflict between NFR-4 (no reflection) and SaveIdProvider reflection tests resolved — is there an explicit exception documented? [Conflict, Spec §NFR-4, §Clarifications] — SATISFIED: Spec clarification Session 2026-09-08: "Use reflection to set Constants.SaveFolderName via BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static." Tasks T083: "Only allowed in SaveIdProviderTests for Constants.SaveFolderName." Explicit exception documented.
- [x] CHK040 Is the ambiguity in FR-1.11's "capped at 5" resolved — does the cap prevent incrementing beyond 5, or does it clamp the value to 5? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-1.11] — SATISFIED: Data model §Maturation Rules: "MaturationLevel += 1 (capped at 5)". Validation: "MaturationLevel must be between 1 and MaturationMaxLevel (5)". Cap prevents incrementing beyond 5 — level stays at 5 indefinitely until reset by 14 idle days.
- [x] CHK041 Is the ambiguity in FR-6.2's "null/empty" return resolved — is there a single expected return value? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-6.2] — SATISFIED: Contracts §SaveIdProviderTests: both null and empty return `null` (not string.Empty). Tasks T073: "null → returns null", T074: "empty → returns null". Single expected return value: `null`.
- [x] CHK042 Is the overlap between Fix-1 (cross-day elapsed time) and Fix-4 (Game1 interface extraction) clarified — does Fix-1 depend on Fix-4, or can they be implemented independently? [Dependency, Spec §Fix-1, Fix-4] — SATISFIED: Fix-1 requires ITimeProvider.TotalDays, which is created in Fix-4. Plan Phase 2 orders Fix-4 (T006-T011) before Fix-1 (T012-T017). Fix-1 depends on Fix-4 — cannot be implemented independently.
